entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return some cycling shoes. Just tell me if I can do it, yes or no. I have the order number when you're ready.
Okay, I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, could you briefly tell me what the specific issue is with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
Look, they don't fit right. They're giving me awful blisters on my heels. I tried moving the cleats around, but it didn't help. I just want my money back. Can you process the refund or not?
I understand completely. Blisters are definitely no good for a ride. Let me just pull up your order to check the policy. What's that order number?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Level cycling shoes, delivered about 80 days ago. You are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.

Yes, absolutely. I've just authorized the return. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Okay, got the email. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
